effects.tier1: 4 psychic damage; I < 0 the target makes a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against a creature of the cackler's choice
effects.tier2: 5 psychic damage; I < 1 the target makes a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against a creature of the cackler's choice
effects.tier3: 7 psychic damage; I < 2 the target uses a signature ability against a creature of the cackler's choice

effects.effect: Whenever a non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) ally within 5 squares of the cackler is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), the cackler moves up to their speed and can make a melee [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).
